verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (368 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-5 pts, p=0.0999).
Magnet beta: fix 0.0048 (t=0.39) vs placebo 0.005 (t=0.5). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
